items.title: Dave Brubeck — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions the King of Thailand is a big jazz fan and had requested Dave Brubeck, but Brubeck does not describe a personal relationship or meeting.

ctx.x: “. . . Thailand. Can you get on the next plane and come?”
The King of Thailand is a big jazz fan.
